title: 柔和工具
referenceRole: actual Showcase screenshot; visual style reference adapted from mobile-oriented guidance to desktop
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity Chinese desktop B2B component-library style exploration image labeled "F  柔和工具" for Mono Design, inspired by the supplied actual StyleKit Soft Utility screenshot.
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE: Image 1 is a style reference only: take the deep teal, pale mint-white ground, soft rounded controls, restrained borders, quiet hierarchy and task-focused character. Build the NEW resource-management screen below, not the reference page. Its source is mobile-oriented; adapt its palette and component language to DESKTOP workflows, without introducing mobile bottom navigation or changing the information architecture. No older generated UI is being edited.

Canvas: flat front-facing landscape UI design specimen, approximately 1600x1100 logical composition, crisp high-resolution Chinese text, no device frame, perspective or surrounding objects. Small specimen banner "F  柔和工具" plus "MONO DESIGN / SOFT UTILITY". Upper 70% complete resource-management app, lower 25% component state specimen. This is a working-tool UI exploration, not a card gallery, marketing page, wellness illustration or empty aesthetic moodboard.

Visual direction: gently mint-tinted off-white #F4F8F6 page ground, white or near-white functional surfaces, deep teal #2D5B63 primary controls and navigation emphasis, strong ink #203B40 text. Pale mint #A9D8CC supports selection and successful states; apricot #F3C98B for draft/attention; dusty rose #E6B7B0 for error surfaces with DARK legible rose-brown error text; muted blue #B8C9ED only for an informational cue if needed. Color denotes meaningful state rather than decorative rainbow blocks. Never use pastel mint for important text on white. Keep dark readable labels, restrained muted helper text, subtle but visible gray-green borders and row rules. Consistent softened corners: approximately 12px controls and 16px panels; practical 38-40px control heights, around 48px table rows. Slightly softer than conventional enterprise blue UI, without toy-like oversized pills, exaggerated roundness, balloon forms or rubbery depth. Subtle small neutral shadows only when necessary, no neumorphism, no glass, no gradients, no decorative textures. Chinese system sans-serif with semi-bold 28px-equivalent title and readable 14px-equivalent body. Comfortable but purposeful density. All functional regions aligned on a disciplined grid.

Same scenario as prior studies: white/light-mint slim left sidebar with "Mono" wordmark and simple outline icons. Nav "概览", active "资源管理", "组件规范", "设置"; active item soft mint rounded rectangle, deep teal text/icon, no black slabs or blue branding. Main header "资源管理", subtitle "管理团队资源与访问状态"; primary button "新增资源" deep teal with white text. Toolbar search "搜索资源", select "全部状态", date range "2026/10/01 — 2026/10/31". Inputs are rounded outlined controls with visible borders, distinct focus and reserved helper space.
Body has team tree titled "团队" with "产品组", "设计组", "工程组"; product group expanded into "产品文档" and "需求资料". Tree remains a compact working navigation pane, not pastel decorative cards.
Four-row central selectable resource table: columns "资源名称", "负责人", "状态", "更新时间". Rows "设计规范 v1", "组件清单", "交付检查", "测试数据", short Chinese owner names and dates in October 2026. Quiet tinted header with dark text, simple horizontal row rules, no heavy black grid. One selected row pale mint and deep teal checkbox. Status tags text "已启用", "草稿", "已停用" with appropriate icon/dot, mint/apricot/dusty-rose surfaces and DARK readable text. Pagination "共 4 条", rounded page 1 deep teal, arrows and page size.
Right form titled "新建资源" on an airy but efficient rounded pale-white panel. Labels "资源名称", "负责人", "资源分类". Empty name outlined dusty rose, dark error icon/text "请填写资源名称". Owner/category selectors. Compact rounded dashed upload "上传附件" with file item "design-spec.pdf", "2.4 MB" and remove affordance. Footer predictable outline "取消", deep-teal "保存". Keep all labels and error feedback strongly legible.

Bottom white softly rounded specimen panel with coherent group headings: primary/secondary/disabled buttons "主要操作", "次要操作", "不可用"; default, focus, success and error inputs with visible outline/feedback; checkboxes, radios and switches with meaningful selected/unselected states; small calendar "2026年10月" with deep-teal selected day; a few mint/apricot/rose status tags with labels. Focus state deep teal clear outline plus clean light gap, not a blurred halo. Disabled state remains identifiable. Do not turn the specimen into oversized cards or a low-contrast pastel wall. Keep top application and entire bottom specimen within margins without clipping. Distinctively Soft Utility: calm everyday precision, supportive status colors and approachable shapes, while still fitting complex B2B usage.
status: comparison candidate; not selected or implemented
